about_the_game:
Follow Laurel through her school day and learn what happened that's causing her so much guilt. With only 100 HP for her energy, and using candy and lunch to help replenish it, can you make it through Laurel's Day and get her locket back? 

Unlike traditional RPGs, Laurel's Day is about Laurel navigating classroom questions, and a concerned community that surrounds her; all in order to conserve her energy to make it to the end of the day. Using her imagination to get through everything, a fairy named Lloen is able to turn Laurel into Katja, her inner confidence that can handle any 'monster' that stands in her way. Can you solve the puzzle to get Laurel her locket back?

Did you know that Laurel's Day is actually another game made to be inside of the game Dimensional Gates also being made by Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios? That's right, we programmed two games at the same time. But if you like Laurel's Day, Dimensional Gates is an extremely long and powerful new storyline that you've never been through before as well.

content_descriptors.notes: Strong mature themes such as death, psychological break down; with classroom lessons on systematic slavery, human trafficking, fascism, and Stalinism

detailed_description:
Mental Health Message

We all have to be there for each other, and we never know who's alone and who isn't. If you or someone you know are going through a mental health crisis, even if you don't know them well, please be there and let them know that MentalHealth  .com has the resources that can help. 


Important Game Information

For those not familiar with RPG Maker titles, there are a few things to know:

F4 - Full Screen Mode

F5 - Restart Game

The Steam Overlay can leave images in the black border of the game's engine, using F4 to leave full screen and return will clean that up. Sorry for the inconvenience, but it's a glitch in the overlay.
